title: Accelerating the Mitigation of LLM Inference Nondeterminism Across GPU Architectures
selection_reason: Cross-GPU reproducible LLM inference is implemented with fixed-configuration fused-upcast GEMM kernels and reports 1.17–3.1x end-to-end speedups over the prior deterministic approach, making it directly relevant to inference kernels and runtime reproducibility.
